pattern.short_summary: The system displays its own reading of what the user supplied — the construal, the inferred intent, the context it thinks it is in — as a first-class object rather than only acting on it.
pattern.definition: The system displays its own reading of what the user supplied — the construal, the inferred intent, the context it thinks it is in — as a first-class object rather than only acting on it. The user can therefore see where the system's understanding diverges from their own, and in several cases can edit that understanding directly. The displayed object stands between the user's input and whatever the system produces next.
pattern.structural_signature: An inference step over the user's input emits a named artifact (graph, keyword overlay, natural-language restatement, schema instance) that is rendered persistently on screen; downstream behaviour is conditioned on that artifact. Where the artifact is editable, edits to it — not to the original input — are the channel by which the user corrects the system.

dimension.category_description: How evidence, internals, correspondence, quality, interpretations, and planned actions are represented for human judgment.
dimension.classification_boundary: The representation must support understanding or verification, rather than merely render output into a usable medium.
